versions.changelog:
Initial release: read-only diagnostics for Alibaba Cloud CDN origin configuration to OSS buckets.

- Diagnoses issues like CDN back-to-origin 403, private bucket authorization, CDN bypass to OSS, incorrect origin host/port, or offline domains.
- Enforces strict read-only execution: never changes CDN/OSS settings, never suggests user-run mutating commands.
- Requires all diagnostics to use provided wrapper scripts; no direct API or CLI calls.
- Handles credential resolution via environment/default chain; never prints or requests access keys.
- All findings are grounded in script/query output with clear status and next-action reporting.
- Validates configuration questions against official documentation with mandatory URL citation.
